profile.headline: Tech Support | Full-Stack | SWE | DevOps | Cloud | Networking
profile.summary: Customer‑focused Full-stack architect & developer with 4+ years of hands-on application development, API design, systems troubleshooting, and AWS cloud deployment experience — building responsive front-ends with React and Next.js, designing RESTful backends with Node.js, FastAPI, and PostgreSQL, and automating data pipelines with Python, technical support, systems troubleshooting, and infrastructure experience, experienced providing desktop/server support, resolving cross-vendor incidents, and training end users— with a security-conscious approaches with configuring router and switch topologies, applied ACLs, supported desktop/server environments,

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Engineered a JSON-driven static-site generator in Python rendering ~261 product catalog pages from a single source of truth, eliminating manual page-drift updates
- Architected a 44-agent AI compliance pipeline that validates marketplace listings against Amazon, Etsy, Walmart, and FDA/MoCRA cosmetics rules before publish
- Built an internal retrieval-augmented (RAG) chatbot with ChromaDB and prompt-injection controls, giving staff source-grounded answers instead of manual searches
- Built AI-agent and knowledge-graph-based automation to diagnose and close SEO/content gaps across the company's website, Google Shopping, and Amazon listings

positions.title: AI/ML Software Engineer Resident
positions.description:
- Built 5+ full-stack applications using TypeScript, Next.js, FastAPI, and Python
- Fine-tuned LLMs, achieved ~95% accuracy on model responses
- Built RAG pipelines integrating ChromaDB, vector search, and embeddings for semantic document retrieval

positions.title: Senior Associate
positions.description:
- Led design and implementation of a microservices architecture using Java and Spring Boot, improving system scalability and reducing deployment time by approximately 30–40%
- Led a team of 5 developers implementing a React.js frontend for Fenergo CLM software, improving UI response time by about 40% and mobile user satisfaction by close to 65%
- Wrote technical documentation for a microservices architecture and RESTful Service references, reducing new-hire onboarding time by roughly 30% and cutting support tickets by roughly 25%
- Built an event-driven database health-check system using PowerShell and Python, enabling early detection of potential issues and reducing downtime
- Triaged, troubleshot, and escalated 10 to 25 cross-vendor incidents monthly, driving SLA-bound resolution of infrastructure issues and outages
- Monitored and maintained financial systems with 99.9% uptime, resolving time-sensitive production issues during market hours

positions.title: Full-Stack Developer Resident
positions.description:
- Built responsive web interfaces using React, React Router, and Redux for state management.
- Developed RESTful APIs with Express.js, Node.js, Flask, and FastAPI, implementing CRUD operations and custom middleware.
- Delivered full-stack projects including a venue-booking database, a Trivia API, and a coffee-shop ordering platform.
- Containerized and deployed a Flask application to AWS EKS through a CI/CD pipeline.
- Completed an intensive full-stack engineering residency covering frontend, backend, databases, and cloud deployment.

positions.title: Software Engineer — Self-Directed Training (Udacity Data Structures & Algorithms Nanodegree)
positions.description:
- Implemented 6 custom data structures from scratch in Python, including an LRU Cache, Huffman Coding compression algorithm, blockchain, and recursive file-system traversal, each validated with a dedicated test suite
- Solved advanced algorithm design problems spanning binary search, rotated-array search, the Dutch National Flag problem, and a Trie-based autocomplete/HTTP router, focusing on optimal time/space complexity trade-offs
- Analyzed algorithmic complexity (Big-O) across a case study on telecom call-log data, applying set operations and pattern analysis to identify telemarketer behavior at scale
- Built a GPS-style route planner implementing the A* search algorithm over graph data, with interactive map visualization for shortest-path finding
- Maintained a fully tested Python codebase (pytest) following Black/isort formatting standards across all four Nanodegree modules

positions.title: Full-Stack Developer — Self-Directed Training (Udacity Nanodegree)
positions.description:
- Built and deployed 5 full-stack web applications using Flask, SQLAlchemy, and PostgreSQL, covering relational data modeling, RESTful API design, automated testing, third-party authentication, and CI/CD deployment
- Designed Fyyur, a venue/artist booking platform, using Flask and SQLAlchemy ORM with PostgreSQL and server-rendered Jinja2 templates for full CRUD across artists, venues, and shows
- Developed a RESTful trivia API (Flask + React) with a full unittest suite, implementing pagination, category filtering, and search endpoints
- Implemented Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) with Auth0 across two apps — a coffee-shop ordering platform (Flask + Ionic/TypeScript) and a casting-agency Capstone API (Flask + PostgreSQL) — enforcing distinct permission scopes per role
- Containerized a Flask microservice with Docker and built a CircleCI pipeline to lint, test, and deploy it to a Kubernetes cluster on AWS EKS

positions.title: Freelance Web Developer & IT Support
positions.description:
- Installed, configured, and maintained desktop systems, servers, and software for local business clients, providing ongoing IT support
- Provided IT support and system troubleshooting for manufacturing operations, securing local workstations and restoring uptime

positions.title: Software Trainee
positions.description:
- Delivered technical training on programming fundamentals, data structures, and software engineering best practices to new hires
- Facilitated hands-on workshops covering Git/GitHub version control, Agile development workflows, and CI/CD pipeline security practices

educations.schoolName: LDRP Institute of Technology & Research, Gujarat Technological University

projects.title: AI Video Chat — Encrypted P2P Video Platform
projects.description:
WebRTC + FastAPI with secure session management and authenticated API
endpoints. Python, SQLAlchemy.

projects.title: Capstone – Casting Agency API
projects.description:
Python, Flask, PostgreSQL, SQLAlchemy, Auth0, RBAC, RESTful API Design

Built and deployed a role-based access control API for managing actors and movies, using Flask and SQLAlchemy with a PostgreSQL database. Implemented Auth0 authentication across three permission tiers (Casting Assistant, Casting Director, Executive Producer) over 8 RESTful endpoints (GET/POST/PATCH/DELETE), with database migrations, seed data, and a full test suite. Deployed to Heroku. Capstone project for Udacity's Full Stack Web Developer Nanodegree.


URL	https://github.com/vpress000/Capstone
